package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"strings"

	bolt "go.etcd.io/bbolt"
)

func main() {
	path := os.Args[1]
	os.Remove(path)
	db, err := bolt.Open(path, 0o600, &bolt.Options{PageSize: 1024})
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	err = db.Update(func(tx *bolt.Tx) error {
		s, _ := tx.CreateBucket([]byte("small"))
		s.Put([]byte("a"), []byte("1"))
		s.Put([]byte("b"), []byte(""))
		s.Put([]byte("c"), []byte(strings.Repeat("x", 5000)))
		big, _ := tx.CreateBucket([]byte("big"))
		for i := 0; i < 600; i++ {
			big.Put([]byte(fmt.Sprintf("k%05d", i)), []byte(fmt.Sprintf("v%d", i*7)))
		}
		o, _ := tx.CreateBucket([]byte("outer"))
		in, _ := o.CreateBucket([]byte("inner"))
		in.Put([]byte("deep"), []byte("value"))
		lg, _ := o.CreateBucket([]byte("large"))
		for i := 0; i < 120; i++ {
			lg.Put([]byte(fmt.Sprintf("n%04d", i)), []byte(strings.Repeat("y", 20)))
		}
		o.Put([]byte("plain"), []byte("here"))
		tx.CreateBucket([]byte("empty"))
		sc, _ := tx.CreateBucket([]byte("_schema"))
		sc.Put([]byte("version"), []byte{0, 0, 0, 1})
		return nil
	})
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	// A second transaction, so the newer meta is page 1's or 0's by turns.
	db.Update(func(tx *bolt.Tx) error { return tx.Bucket([]byte("small")).Put([]byte("d"), []byte("later")) })
	db.Close()
	db2, _ := bolt.Open(os.Args[2], 0o600, &bolt.Options{PageSize: 1024})
	db2.Update(func(tx *bolt.Tx) error { tx.CreateBucket([]byte("_schema")); tx.CreateBucket([]byte("queues")); return nil })
	db2.Close()
}
